verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents change notifications that alert applications when a resource they care about is created, updated, or deleted [onedrive-docs-7], and delta queries for tracking driveItem changes [onedrive-docs-6, onedrive-docs-21]. This establishes a first-party push mechanism. However, the evidence does not explicitly tie notifications to driveItem/OneDrive resources and says nothing about how deliveries are verified or retried. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that change notifications fire for OneDrive driveItems, documented endpoint validation/signature verification, documented retry/delivery semantics, hands-on corroboration.
